item.title: Entropy‐Compensated Electrolyte Enables Low‐Temperature 400 Wh Kg −1 Silicon‐Based Lithium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an entropy-compensation strategy that raises solvation entropy to counteract low-temperature ion pairing, forming smaller anion-rich clusters and tripling ionic conductivity at −20°C. Its significance: this thermodynamic descriptor (ΔS_solv) enables Si-anode Li-ion pouch cells achieving 400 Wh kg⁻¹, 339 Wh kg⁻¹ at low temperature, 97.8% capacity retention over 165 cycles at −20°C, and discharge at −81°C.

item.title: Stabilizing High‐Voltage Oxygen Holes via π‐Bonding Mediated Frontier‐Orbital Character Inversion in Intermediate‐Regime Oxide Cathodes
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in stabilizing high-voltage oxygen holes in Li₂RuO₃ by tuning Ru─O π-bonding, inducing a frontier-orbital character inversion during delithiation. This avoids destabilizing O─O dimerization and voltage hysteresis. Significance: it establishes an electronic-structure design principle—orbital engineering in intermediate-regime oxides between Mott–Hubbard and charge-transfer behavior—enabling stable, high-voltage anionic redox and higher energy density.
🏷 oxygen redox · layered oxide cathode · Li2RuO3 · orbital engineering · voltage hysteresis

item.title: Bidirectional Sulfur Redox Regulation Enabling Ultra‐Stable High‐Sulfur‐Loading All‐Solid‐State Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in an amorphous-crystalline Li6.05P0.95Nb0.05S5Cl0.8I0.2 electrolyte enabling bidirectional sulfur redox regulation: Nb4+→Nb3+ reduction promotes Li2S nucleation during discharge, while I−→I2 mediates Li2S oxidation during charge. This achieves 84.2% sulfur utilization at 6 mg cm−2 loading and 93.1% retention after 1500 cycles, advancing high-loading all-solid-state Li-S batteries.
🏷 all-solid-state Li-S battery · solid electrolyte · sulfur redox · high sulfur loading · Nb doping
